module.name: http
module.purpose: Provides static telemetry browser assets with compact tag-option spacing, session selection, Level, Tags, and keyword filters, virtualized logs, incremental paging, and formatted-message inspection. Open dropdowns survive streaming log updates and log-area scrolling, refreshing their options in place instead of closing. Log rows highlight on hover, open the formatted message on left click, and copy the log on right click. Only session ID changes clear selected tags, close the Tags dropdown, and refresh logs; Level and keyword filters persist, and same-session refreshes retain tag state.
